step1.p: Copy your case URL from Behance address bar and paste it into the field.

step2.p: We will fetch native project tags, or you can add custom ones to discover new niches.

step3.p: Robot checks positions daily. You will see rank trends on visual charts.

items.a: Click 'New Project' in sidebar. Paste direct Behance URL. Enter tags comma separated. Click launch to start scanning.
'In Queue' — project waiting for parser. 'Analyzing...' — scanner active. 'Active' — data loaded.

items.q: How to read the position chart?
items.a: Chart is inverted: higher point means better rank (#1 is at the top).

items.q: How to see exact rank numbers?
items.a: Hover over any chart point to open Tooltip with exact ranks.
TOP-10 and Potential filters isolate best tags quickly.
Click 'Copy List' to copy all tags comma separated for Behance settings.
When ON, system automatically updates rankings on plan schedule.
